about_the_game:
Demo Description

This is a demo version of the psychological horror game Mara. You are stuck in the middle of a gloomy forest near an abandoned gas station! From the things you have with you only a flashlight and a couple of tools! Surround and spatial sound helps you to immerse into this atmosphere!

The demo version of Mara offers a full version of the beginning of the main game. In it, you will have to experience the feeling of being watched by someone, explore the surroundings of the gas station and the forest, and solve several puzzles to help a strange stranger!

The demo introduces the player to the basic mechanics of the game's advantages:

  • Spatial and surround sound

  • The main atmosphere, tone and visual style of the full version of the game.

  • The game is in English and Russian, single-player, with mouse/keyboard support.

In the full version of Mara, you are waiting for

  • More locations.

  • More puzzles.

  • More fear and horror.

- For full immersion in the atmosphere it is strongly recommended to use headphones or earphones.
